matches.rationale: Several findings converge on the same underlying defect: the operation ⊙_t / ⊙_{l,k} introduced around Section 2.2 (page 4) is mis-stated or mis-applied, producing wrong group claims (3), a wrong zero-element/expression (4), a miscalculated factor in a downstream proof (8), and a directly verifiable numeric mismatch in the formula's application (11). Finding 2 also targets the same locus (the integrality condition tied to the operation's definition). Together these identify the same root issue — the expression/definition of p⊙_t q being incorrect and undermining dependent results.
